interpretation: Supabase-managed defaults for GraphQL and public/storage schemas can include broad anon/authenticated table/sequence/function grants; future objects still need RLS and explicit publication review.
Public schema defaults depend on creating role. postgres-created public functions default to postgres/service_role only, while supabase_admin-created functions default to client EXECUTE.
No PUBLIC role grants in current rows, but per-object inherited effective privileges and HTTP schema exposure remain unverified.
No safe modification to live provider defaults or automatically created future objects is authorized.
